top_signals.title: Why Hong Kong Developer New World Is Struggling With Debt
top_signals.summary: Once a symbol of Hong Kong’s property-fueled prosperity, New World Development Co. has become one of its most visible casualties. After years of easy credit and aggressive expansion, the property giant – once among the most deep-pocketed in the city – is facing a financial reckoning.
